violence.rationale: Subtitle dialogue repeatedly contains direct threats to kill, references to poisoning as a weapon and a timed murder game, and hostage/family-death threats. There are mentions of shooting and people screaming, but no graphic gore in the dialogue, so this matches 'moderate'.
evidence: Your aim in this game is to kill Adam
If you do not kill Adam by six then Alison and Diana will die Dr Gordon

sex.rationale: Dialogue includes explicit sexual references and crude sexual talk (mention of lubricant and 'fuck' used in a sexual context), but no on-screen nudity described in the subtitles; this fits 'moderate'.
evidence: This is the most fun I've had without lubricant.
I get paid to take pictures of rich guys like you, who go to seedy motels to fuck their secretaries.

language.rationale: Subtitles contain frequent strong profanity including multiple uses of the f-word and other strong insults, so the language severity is 'strong'.
evidence: Get your fucking hands off my daughter!

substances.rationale: Dialogue repeatedly references drugging/poisoning, tranquility drugs and states a character is a 'drug addict' (addiction as a theme), plus incidental alcohol and smoking references — this meets the 'strong' level.
evidence: You are, in fact, a drug addict. Isn't that right, Mandy?
I need more- powerful tranquillizers next time.
We're gonna go down to get a beer.
